vocabulary.meaning: The omission of the doer of the action in a passive construction

meaning_translation.Hindi: निष्क्रिय वाक्य में क्रिया करने वाले को छोड़ देना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 受動態で行為者を省略すること

examples.sentence: Mistakes were made — an example of agent suppression.

translation.Hindi: गलतियाँ की गईं — कर्ता दमन का एक उदाहरण।
translation.Japanese: 間違いが犯された — 行為者省略の例です。

vocabulary.meaning: The person or thing performing an action

meaning_translation.Hindi: वह व्यक्ति या चीज़ जो कोई कार्य करता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 行動を行う人またはもの

examples.sentence: In 'The book was written by Orwell', Orwell is the agent.

translation.Hindi: 'The book was written by Orwell' में, Orwell कर्ता है।
translation.Japanese: 'The book was written by Orwell' では、Orwell が行為者です。

vocabulary.meaning: A sentence where the subject receives the action instead of performing it

meaning_translation.Hindi: ऐसा वाक्य जहाँ कर्ता कार्य को करता नहीं बल्कि प्राप्त करता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 主語が行動を行うのではなく受ける文

translation.Japanese: その決定は昨日なされました。

vocabulary.meaning: A passive form with no specific subject, often using 'it' or no agent

meaning_translation.Hindi: एक निष्क्रिय रूप जिसमें कोई विशिष्ट कर्ता नहीं होता, अक्सर 'it' या कोई कर्ता नहीं होता
meaning_translation.Japanese: 特定の主語がなく、「it」や行為者なしで使われる受動態

examples.sentence: It is said that the policy will change.

translation.Hindi: कहा जाता है कि नीति बदल जाएगी।
translation.Japanese: その政策は変わると言われています。

vocabulary.meaning: Using the passive voice to report information without naming the source

meaning_translation.Hindi: स्रोत का नाम लिए बिना जानकारी रिपोर्ट करने के लिए निष्क्रिय वाक्य का उपयोग करना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 情報源を示さずに情報を報告するために受動態を使うこと

examples.sentence: It was announced that new laws would be introduced.

translation.Hindi: घोषणा की गई कि नए कानून लागू किए जाएंगे।
translation.Japanese: 新しい法律が導入されると発表されました。

vocabulary.meaning: Language style used in serious or official contexts

meaning_translation.Hindi: भाषा की शैली जो गंभीर या आधिकारिक संदर्भों में उपयोग की जाती है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 公式や真面目な場面で使われる言語のスタイル

examples.sentence: Agentless passives are common in a formal register.

translation.Hindi: औपचारिक शैली में कर्ता रहित निष्क्रिय वाक्य आम हैं।
translation.Japanese: フォーマルな文体では行為者のない受動態がよく使われます。

vocabulary.meaning: Turning verbs into nouns to sound more formal and abstract

meaning_translation.Hindi: क्रियाओं को संज्ञाओं में बदलना ताकि अधिक औपचारिक और अमूर्त लगे
meaning_translation.Japanese: 動詞を名詞に変えて、よりフォーマルで抽象的にすること

examples.sentence: The introduction of new measures was announced.

translation.Hindi: नई उपायों की शुरुआत की घोषणा की गई।
translation.Japanese: 新しい施策の導入が発表されました。

vocabulary.meaning: The part of a passive sentence that shows who did the action

meaning_translation.Hindi: निष्क्रिय वाक्य का वह भाग जो बताता है कि कार्य किसने किया
meaning_translation.Japanese: 受動態の文で誰が行動をしたかを示す部分

examples.sentence: The painting was created by an unknown artist.

translation.Hindi: चित्र एक अज्ञात कलाकार द्वारा बनाया गया था।
translation.Japanese: その絵は無名の画家によって描かれました。

vocabulary.meaning: Using 'to be + past participle' to express a passive action in infinitive form

meaning_translation.Hindi: 'to be + past participle' का उपयोग करके निष्क्रिय क्रिया को infinitive रूप में व्यक्त करना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 受動態の動作を不定詞で表す「to be + 過去分詞」の形

examples.sentence: The report is to be submitted tomorrow.

translation.Hindi: रिपोर्ट कल प्रस्तुत की जानी है।
translation.Japanese: その報告書は明日提出されることになっています。

vocabulary.meaning: A passive structure where someone causes something to be done (e.g., 'had it repaired')

meaning_translation.Hindi: एक निष्क्रिय संरचना जिसमें कोई व्यक्ति किसी कार्य को करवाता है (जैसे, 'had it repaired')
meaning_translation.Japanese: 誰かが何かをさせることを示す受動態の構造（例：had it repaired）

examples.sentence: She had the document signed by the director.

translation.Hindi: उसने दस्तावेज़ को निदेशक से हस्ताक्षरित करवाया।
translation.Japanese: 彼女はその書類に監督の署名をさせた。

grammar_tips.title: Agentless Passive for Formal Objectivity
grammar_tips.explanation: Use the passive without a 'by-phrase' to sound objective or avoid naming responsibility. Example: 'It was decided to postpone the meeting.'

explanation_translation.Hindi: वस्तुनिष्ठ दिखने या जिम्मेदारी का नाम लेने से बचने के लिए 'by-phrase' के बिना निष्क्रिय का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: 'It was decided to postpone the meeting.'
explanation_translation.Japanese: 客観的に聞こえるように、または責任者を明示しないためにby句なしの受動態を使います。例：It was decided to postpone the meeting.

grammar_tips.title: Impersonal Passive with Reporting Verbs
grammar_tips.explanation: Combine verbs like 'say', 'believe', 'report' with passive for formal statements. Example: 'It is believed that the policy will fail.'

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'say', 'believe', 'report' जैसे क्रियाओं को निष्क्रिय के साथ मिलाकर औपचारिक कथन बनाएं। उदाहरण: 'It is believed that the policy will fail.'
explanation_translation.Japanese: 「say」「believe」「report」などの動詞を受動態と組み合わせてフォーマルな表現にします。例：It is believed that the policy will fail.

grammar_tips.title: Nominalization with Passive Forms
grammar_tips.explanation: Transform verbs into nouns to combine with passive, making statements formal and dense. Example: 'The implementation was delayed.'

explanation_translation.Hindi: क्रियाओं को संज्ञाओं में बदलकर निष्क्रिय के साथ जोड़ें ताकि कथन औपचारिक और गहन लगें। उदाहरण: 'The implementation was delayed.'
explanation_translation.Japanese: 動詞を名詞に変えて受動態と組み合わせることで、文をフォーマルで重厚にします。例：The implementation was delayed.

vocabulary.question: Which term refers to leaving out the doer in a passive sentence?

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा शब्द निष्क्रिय वाक्य में क्रिया करने वाले को छोड़ने को संदर्भित करता है?
question_translation.Japanese: 受動態の文で行為者を省略することを指す用語はどれですか？

vocabulary.question: Mistakes were ___ during the process — the agent is not mentioned.

question_translation.Hindi: प्रक्रिया के दौरान गलतियाँ ___ — कर्ता का उल्लेख नहीं किया गया है।
question_translation.Japanese: 過程で間違いが___された — 行為者は言及されていません。

vocabulary.question: Impersonal passives often use 'it' to avoid specifying who acts.

question_translation.Hindi: निष्प्राण निष्क्रिय अक्सर 'it' का उपयोग करते हैं ताकि यह न बताया जाए कि कौन कार्य कर रहा है।
question_translation.Japanese: 非人称受動態は誰が行動しているかを特定しないために「it」を使うことがよくあります。

vocabulary.question: Which structure expresses a passive action in infinitive form?

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सी संरचना निष्क्रिय क्रिया को infinitive रूप में व्यक्त करती है?
question_translation.Japanese: どの構造が不定詞で受動態の動作を表しますか？

vocabulary.question: The document was signed ___ the director.

question_translation.Hindi: दस्तावेज़ पर निदेशक ___ हस्ताक्षर किए गए।
question_translation.Japanese: その書類は監督___署名されました。

question_translation.Hindi: व्यवस्थित करें: [was, delayed, implementation, the]
question_translation.Japanese: 並べ替え: [was, delayed, implementation, the]

sentence.question: It was ___ that the company would merge next year.

question_translation.Hindi: यह ___ गया कि कंपनी अगले साल विलय करेगी।
question_translation.Japanese: 会社が来年合併すると___されました。

sentence.question: Select the most formal sentence using agent suppression:

question_translation.Hindi: कर्ता दमन का उपयोग करते हुए सबसे औपचारिक वाक्य चुनें:
question_translation.Japanese: 行為者省略を使った最もフォーマルな文を選んでください:

options: It was decided to close the factory.
We decided to close the factory.

sentence.question: Arrange: [to, submitted, be, tomorrow, report, the]

question_translation.Hindi: व्यवस्थित करें: [to, submitted, be, tomorrow, report, the]
question_translation.Japanese: 並べ替え: [to, submitted, be, tomorrow, report, the]

sentence.question: The machine was ___ by a skilled technician.

question_translation.Hindi: मशीन को एक कुशल तकनीशियन द्वारा ___ गया।
question_translation.Japanese: その機械は熟練した技術者によって___されました。

listening.question: What passive construction is used here?
listening.audio_text: It is believed that the plan will succeed.

question_translation.Hindi: यहाँ किस प्रकार का निष्क्रिय निर्माण उपयोग किया गया है?
question_translation.Japanese: ここで使われている受動態の構造はどれですか？

listening.question: The sentence avoids naming the agent.

question_translation.Hindi: वाक्य कर्ता का नाम लेने से बचता है।
question_translation.Japanese: その文は行為者の名前を避けています。

listening.question: What does 'had the document signed' show?
listening.audio_text: She had the document signed by the lawyer.

question_translation.Hindi: 'had the document signed' क्या दर्शाता है?
question_translation.Japanese: 「had the document signed」は何を示していますか？

listening.question: What feature is shown in 'Mistakes were made'?
listening.audio_text: Mistakes were made during the operation.

question_translation.Hindi: 'Mistakes were made' में कौन सी विशेषता दिखाई गई है?
question_translation.Japanese: 「Mistakes were made」に示されている特徴は何ですか？

listening.question: Passive infinitives can describe future planned actions.
listening.audio_text: The new system is to be implemented next month.

question_translation.Hindi: निष्क्रिय infinitive भविष्य की योजनाबद्ध क्रियाओं को व्यक्त कर सकते हैं।
question_translation.Japanese: 受動態不定詞は将来の予定された行動を表すことができます。

speaking.question: Say: 'It was decided to postpone the meeting.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'It was decided to postpone the meeting.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'It was decided to postpone the meeting.'

speaking.answer: it was decided to postpone the meeting

speaking.question: Say: 'The report is to be submitted tomorrow.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'The report is to be submitted tomorrow.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'The report is to be submitted tomorrow.'

speaking.answer: the report is to be submitted tomorrow

speaking.question: Say: 'It is believed that the policy will change.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'It is believed that the policy will change.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'It is believed that the policy will change.'

speaking.answer: it is believed that the policy will change

speaking.question: Say: 'Mistakes were made during the process.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'Mistakes were made during the process.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'Mistakes were made during the process.'

speaking.answer: mistakes were made during the process

speaking.question: Say: 'She had the document signed by the director.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'She had the document signed by the director.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'She had the document signed by the director.'

speaking.answer: she had the document signed by the director
